title: GraphDancer: Training LLMs to Explore and Reason over Graphs via Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.02518v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on external knowledge to improve factuality, yet many knowledge sources on the Web, such as scholarly indexes and product catalogs, are organized as heterogeneous graphs. Reasoning over such graph-structured knowledge poses two key challenges: (1) navigating structured, schema-defined relations requires precise function calls beyond similarity-based retrieval, and (2) answering complex questions often demands multi-hop evidence aggregation through iterative information seeking. We study how LLMs can learn these interaction capabilities and transfer them to unseen domains. We propose GraphDancer, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that teaches LLMs to navigate graphs by interleaving reasoning and function execution. translated_title: GraphDancer：通过课程强化学习训练大语言模型探索和推理图结构
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益依赖外部知识来提升事实准确性，然而网络上的许多知识源，如学术索引和产品目录，都是以异构图的形式组织的。对这种图结构化知识的推理面临两个关键挑战：（1）在结构化的、由模式定义的关系中进行导航，需要超越基于相似性检索的精确函数调用；（2）回答复杂问题通常需要通过迭代式的信息搜寻来聚合多跳证据。我们研究大语言模型如何学习这些交互能力，并将其迁移到未见过的领域。我们提出了GraphDancer，一个强化学习（RL）框架，通过交替进行推理和函数执行来教会大语言模型在图中导航。为了改进针对中等规模大语言模型的强化学习，我们引入了一种图感知课程机制，该机制根据问题的结构难度，以由易到难的方式安排训练。
tldr: GraphDancer是一个强化学习框架，通过图感知的课程式训练（由易到难调度），教会中等规模的大语言模型在异构图知识源上交替进行推理与函数调用，从而实现多跳证据聚合的图导航推理，并将该能力迁移到未见过的领域。
en_tdlr: GraphDancer is a reinforcement learning framework that uses a graph-aware easy-to-hard curriculum to train moderate-sized LLMs to navigate heterogeneous graphs by interleaving reasoning and function execution, enabling multi-hop evidence aggregation and transfer to unseen domains.
